'''Hallam Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was the head of the Organa's diplomatic corps.

==Behind the scenes==
He was voiced by [[Tom Kane]].
